rsi.title: RSI (Relative Strength Index)
rsi.description: RSI is a momentum indicator that shows whether an asset is in an overbought or oversold zone. It takes a value between 0-100 and a 14-period calculation is generally used.

levels.meaning: Overbought zone - Price carries a risk of falling, profit taking can be considered
Oversold zone - Price may offer an opportunity for a rise, can be a buying opportunity
Neutral zone - Shows the strength of the trend

buy_signals.title: Buy Signals
items: If RSI crosses up from below 30
If price makes a new low while RSI turns up from the bottom (positive divergence)

sell_signals.title: Sell Signals
items: If RSI crosses down from above 70
If price makes a new high while RSI turns down from the top (negative divergence)

warnings.title: Warnings
items: In strong trends, RSI can stay in the overbought/oversold zone for a long time
It is important to support it with other indicators instead of using it alone
May give different results in different time frames
Gives more reliable signals in sideways markets

tip.title: Pro Tip
tip.content: Using RSI with volume and trend lines increases signal reliability. Especially divergence signals can foretell trend reversals.

moving_average.title: Moving Averages
moving_average.description: Moving averages help determine trend direction and support/resistance levels by averaging prices over a specific period. This application uses 7, 25, and 99-day periods.

levels.meaning: Short-term trend - Provides fast signals for daily trading
Medium-term trend - Shows weekly/monthly trend direction
Long-term trend - Determines the big picture and main trend direction
Strong uptrend - Buyers are dominant in all periods
Strong downtrend - Sellers are dominant in all periods

buy_signals.title: Buy Signals
items: 7-day MA crosses above 25-day MA (short-term buy)
25-day MA crosses above 99-day MA (medium/long-term strong buy - Golden Cross)
Price finds support at 7 or 25-day MA and turns up
All MAs aligned upwards (7 > 25 > 99)

sell_signals.title: Sell Signals
items: 7-day MA crosses below 25-day MA (short-term sell)
25-day MA crosses below 99-day MA (medium/long-term strong sell - Death Cross)
Price finds resistance at 7 or 25-day MA and turns down
All MAs aligned downwards (7 < 25 < 99)

warnings.title: Warnings
items: In sideways markets, especially the 7-day MA can give many false signals
MAs are lagging indicators, they reflect price movements with a delay
7-day MA is most sensitive to volatility, 99-day is most stable
Short-term MAs can be choppy when volatility is high

tip.title: Pro Tip
tip.content: Use 99-day MA for main trend direction, 25-day MA for entry timing, and 7-day MA for short-term momentum. Alignment of all MAs in the same direction (7>25>99 or 7<25<99) gives the strongest trend signals.

ema.title: Exponential Moving Averages (EMA)
ema.description: EMA is a moving average calculated by giving more weight to recent prices. It reacts faster to price changes compared to Simple Moving Average (SMA). This application uses 7, 25, and 99-day periods.

levels.meaning: Short-term trend - Very fast reaction, ideal for daily trading
Medium-term trend - Balanced speed, suitable for swing trading
Long-term trend - Shows main trend direction, strong support/resistance
Strong uptrend - Momentum is on the buyer side
Strong downtrend - Momentum is on the seller side

buy_signals.title: Buy Signals
items: 7-day EMA crosses above 25-day EMA (short-term buy)
25-day EMA crosses above 99-day EMA (strong uptrend - Golden Cross)
Price finds support at EMAs and turns up (especially 25 or 99-day)
All EMAs aligned upwards (7 > 25 > 99) and distance between them widens

sell_signals.title: Sell Signals
items: 7-day EMA crosses below 25-day EMA (short-term sell)
25-day EMA crosses below 99-day EMA (strong downtrend - Death Cross)
Price finds resistance at EMAs and turns down
All EMAs aligned downwards (7 < 25 < 99) and distance between them widens

warnings.title: Warnings
items: Risk of false signals is higher as it reacts faster than SMA
In sideways markets, 7-day EMA can create too much noise
Can be overly sensitive in sudden price movements
Short-term EMAs can give whipsaw signals in volatile markets

tip.title: Pro Tip
tip.content: Since EMA gives faster signals than SMA, it is suitable for those who want to catch trend changes early. Use 99-day EMA as a main trend filter - consider long positions only when price is above 99 EMA, and short only when below. Distance between EMAs shows trend strength.

bollinger_bands.title: Bollinger Bands
bollinger_bands.description: Bollinger Bands consist of upper and lower bands created using standard deviation around a moving average. It measures price volatility and helps identify overbought/oversold zones. It is generally calculated with a 20-period MA and 2 standard deviations.

levels.meaning: Overbought zone - Selling pressure may occur when price approaches the upper band
Oversold zone - Buying opportunity may occur when price approaches the lower band
Average price level - Acts as support and resistance
Low volatility - A major price movement may be approaching
High volatility - Strong trend movement continues

buy_signals.title: Buy Signals
items: Price touches or drops below the lower band and then reverses
Price finds support at the lower band and moves towards the middle band
Price breaks out towards the upper band after bands contract
Price finds support at the middle band (MA) in an uptrend

sell_signals.title: Sell Signals
items: Price touches or rises above the upper band and then reverses
Price finds resistance at the upper band and moves towards the middle band
Price breaks out towards the lower band after bands contract
Price finds resistance at the middle band (MA) in a downtrend

warnings.title: Warnings
items: Price can stay at the upper or lower band for a long time in strong trends (band walking)
Touching the bands is not a buy/sell signal by itself, confirmation is required
More reliable in sideways markets, can be misleading in strong trends
Bands usually contract before a volatility explosion but do not show the direction

tip.title: Pro Tip
tip.content: Use Bollinger Bands with RSI: price at lower band + RSI below 30 = strong buy signal. A breakout with increased volume after a 'Squeeze' (contraction of bands) can signal the start of a strong trend. %b indicator (price position within bands) provides additional information.

macd.title: MACD (Moving Average Convergence Divergence)
macd.description: MACD is a momentum indicator that shows the difference between two exponential moving averages (EMA). It consists of three components: MACD line, Signal line, and Histogram. Usually 12, 26, and 9 periods are used (MACD: 12-26 EMA difference, Signal: 9-day EMA of MACD).

levels.meaning: Difference between short and long-term EMA - Shows momentum direction
Moving average of MACD - Triggers buy/sell signals
Difference between MACD and Signal - Visualizes momentum strength
Bullish momentum - Short-term EMA is above long-term
Bearish momentum - Short-term EMA is below long-term

buy_signals.title: Buy Signals
items: MACD line crosses above Signal line (Bullish Crossover)
MACD crosses above zero line (strong bullish signal)
Histogram turns from negative to positive and starts growing
Price makes a new low while MACD does not (Bullish Divergence)

sell_signals.title: Sell Signals
items: MACD line crosses below Signal line (Bearish Crossover)
MACD crosses below zero line (strong bearish signal)
Histogram turns from positive to negative and starts shrinking
Price makes a new high while MACD does not (Bearish Divergence)

warnings.title: Warnings
items: May give many false signals in sideways markets
It is a lagging indicator, gives late signals in fast price changes
Crossovers are not enough alone, should align with trend direction
Histogram size shows momentum strength but is not an absolute value

tip.title: Pro Tip
tip.content: Use MACD to determine trend direction and confirm with other indicators. Divergence signals are among the strongest predictors of trend reversals. Histogram growth or shrinkage can show momentum change before MACD crossover. In strong trends, instead of waiting for MACD crossovers, follow histogram direction changes.

donchian_channels.title: Donchian Channels
donchian_channels.description: Donchian Channels consist of an upper band, lower band, and a middle line formed by the highest and lowest prices within a specific period. It helps identify trend direction, breakout points, and volatility. Usually, 20 periods are used.

levels.meaning: Highest price in the period - Resistance level
Lowest price in the period - Support level
Midpoint of upper and lower bands - Trend balance and average price
Strong uptrend - Buyers are dominant
Strong downtrend - Sellers are dominant
Volatility indicator - Wide channel means high, narrow channel means low volatility

buy_signals.title: Buy Signals
items: Price breaks above the upper band (Breakout)
Price finds support at the lower band and moves towards the middle line
Price expands upwards after a narrow channel
Price moves above the middle line and heads towards the upper band

sell_signals.title: Sell Signals
items: Price breaks below the lower band (Breakdown)
Price finds resistance at the upper band and returns towards the middle line
Price expands downwards after a narrow channel
Price drops below the middle line and heads towards the lower band

warnings.title: Warnings
items: May give false breakout signals in sideways markets
Breakouts are not enough alone, should be confirmed with volume and momentum
Narrow channels are a warning before volatility explosion but do not show direction
In strong trends, price can stay at the upper or lower band for a long time

tip.title: Pro Tip
tip.content: Donchian Channels are ideal for breakout strategies. When the channel narrows, a big move is approaching - wait for a breakout with increased volume. The middle line is a key reference for trend direction: above is uptrend, below is downtrend. Use with ATR or Bollinger Bands to confirm breakout strength.

atr.title: ATR (Average True Range)
atr.description: ATR is an indicator that measures market volatility. It calculates the average of the true price range over a specific period. High ATR value means high volatility, low ATR value means low volatility. Usually, 14 periods are used.

levels.meaning: High volatility - Price movements are wide, risk and opportunity increase
Low volatility - Price movements are narrow, consolidation period
Volatility increasing - Strong trend movement or breakout may be coming
Volatility decreasing - Market calming down, may be before a big move

buy_signals.title: Buy Signals
items: When ATR starts rising from low levels, look for buy signal with volume
Sudden rise after low ATR can signal the start of a strong trend
Set stop-loss distance with ATR: below price (e.g., 2x ATR)

sell_signals.title: Sell Signals
items: Consider profit taking when ATR reaches very high levels
If ATR starts falling after peaking, the trend may be weakening
Set stop-loss distance with ATR: above price (e.g., 2x ATR)

warnings.title: Warnings
items: ATR does not give buy/sell signals alone, only measures volatility
High ATR does not always mean trend will continue
Low ATR can persist for a long time, impatience can lead to wrong positions
ATR values of different assets cannot be compared (not absolute, should look relatively)

tip.title: Pro Tip
tip.content: Use ATR for position sizing and stop-loss placement. You can take smaller positions in high ATR, larger positions in low ATR. Placing stop-loss at 1.5-2x ATR distance keeps you safe from normal price fluctuations. Low ATR periods are usually precursors to big moves - be ready for breakout strategies in these periods.

adi.title: Average Directional Index (ADX)
adi.description: ADX is used to quantify trend strength. It measures the strength of a trend but not its direction. It is plotted with two other lines, +DI and -DI, to identify trend direction. Values above 25 generally indicate a strong trend, and below 20 indicate a weak trend.

levels.meaning: Strong trend presence
Weak or no trend
Bullish trend direction
Bearish trend direction

buy_signals.title: Buy Signals
items: +DI crosses above -DI while ADX is rising

sell_signals.title: Sell Signals
items: -DI crosses above +DI while ADX is rising

warnings.title: Warnings
items: ADX does not indicate trend direction, only strength
Lagging indicator, requires confirmation

tip.title: Pro Tip
tip.content: Combine ADX with trend direction indicators. Above 25 ADX confirms a trend strategy is viable.
